name: http2-performance
title: HTTP/2 performance benchmarks
description: 扩展现有独立二进制基准，测量小内存下 HTTP/2 多路复用的吞吐、尾延迟、内存和连接回收。
creator: Antigravity
notes: HTTP/2 benchmark complete: 224 formal cases plus 60 recovery cycles, fixed 1x16/4x16 topology, h2c/TLS and Dever/runtime/Hyper comparisons. All request errors, OOM and FD deltas were zero; 64 MiB active Dever cases passed. Sixteen runner tests, three loopback tests, release cargo check, Dever fmt-check and independent review passed. No full suite, Rustfmt/Clippy, commit or archive.
